# CTRL — Clarity for Leaders

> CTRL is an AI decision-clarity product for senior leaders. It builds a portable "AI double" of you so every AI tool knows your context, pressure-tests your real decisions against live evidence, and — newest — exposes your live Memory Web to your OWN AI agents via a read-only MCP server. Your agents act on who you are *right now*, not a pasted snapshot that goes stale the moment the tab closes.

## What it does
- **Memory Web** — your structured operating context (identity, company, objectives, blockers, confirmed patterns), ranked by importance and kept fresh; contradictions are resolved at write-time and stale facts age out.
- **Context Export** — one-click copy / Markdown export of your context, formatted for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, and Claude Code.
- **Decision engine** — pressure-test a real decision: it decomposes the bet into considerations, verifies the load-bearing claims against the web, and surfaces where *only you* can decide (it clarifies; it never recommends from a thin signal).
- **Daily Briefing** — a ~3-minute audio read anchored to your real priorities.
- **Agent-native (Edge Pro)** — a read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so your own agents pull your live, brain-ranked context on every call. An opt-in scope also exposes today's briefing as a structured feed.

## For AI agents
- **MCP server** (read-only, per-leader API key, requires Edge Pro):
  `https://bkyuxvschuwngtcdhsyg.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-context`
  - Transport: Streamable HTTP (MCP spec 2025-06-18), stateless JSON responses.
  - Tools: `get_leader_context` (the leader's live operating context), `get_todays_briefing` (opt-in scope).
  - Auth: a per-leader key the leader mints in **Settings → Edge Pro** and passes as a bearer token. Read-only; revocable anytime.
- **Machine-readable product facts:** `https://ctrl.themindmaker.ai/.well-known/product.json`

## Who it's for
Senior individual leaders — C-suite, VPs, founders — at 50–5,000-person companies who already use AI daily but get generic output. Not for individual contributors with no team, students, or people wanting a generic chatbot.
